title: Add bounded supplier reconciliation and aging workspace
description: Add a bounded read-only supplier reconciliation and aging workspace over ERP-065 invoices and ERP-066 explicit payment allocations. Derive only arithmetic evidence supported by persisted invoice dates, optional due dates and active allocations. Do not create a general ledger, invent due dates, authorize payment, contact suppliers, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace lists recorded supplier-invoice evidence and active explicit payment allocations without copying source rows or creating another invoice, payment or allocation master.
Users can apply bounded or paged filters for Supplier, invoice identity, invoice-date range, explicit due-date range, currency, invoice status and allocation state using persisted fields only.

For each recorded invoice, arithmetic remaining evidence equals gross amount minus active ERP-066 payment-to-invoice allocations, with over-allocation prevented by the source rules and voided allocations excluded but available in explicit history.

Aging is calculated only when an explicit persisted due date exists, against an explicit as-of date, using documented mutually exclusive buckets; invoices without due dates remain in a separate unknown-due-date group.
Different currencies are grouped separately and are never combined, converted or presented as one total without an authoritative persisted conversion already belonging to source evidence.

Draft or voided invoices are separately labeled and excluded from active payable-evidence totals; missing, invalid or unavailable source links remain visible as unknown or invalid and are not repaired or reassigned.

The workspace distinguishes invoice gross evidence, explicit allocated-payment evidence and arithmetic remainder and states that these are repository reconciliation figures, not a general-ledger balance, audited Supplier statement, payment authorization, tax filing or settlement confirmation.

Opening invoice, allocation or payment detail revalidates existing authentication and module authorization and fails closed when an authoritative source is deleted, unavailable or no longer authorized.
List and aggregate queries are bounded, avoid per-row database access, do not call external services and keep legacy Suppliers with no evidence readable without request-time or production backfill.
The workspace is read-only and does not change Suppliers, invoices, allocations, Purchase Orders, receipts, payments, inventory, tax, finance or settlement records.
Any export uses the same filtered, currency-separated and unknown-due-date semantics as the screen and contains no hidden cross-currency total or inferred legal assertion.

Unit and integration tests cover explicit and missing due dates, all aging boundaries, partial and full allocations, void history, multiple Suppliers and currencies, as-of filtering, bounded queries, authorization failure and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open the supplier reconciliation workspace for recorded invoices with explicit due dates and partial payment allocations, select an as-of date, and verify currency-separated remaining evidence and documented aging buckets.
Inspect draft, voided, missing-due-date, invalid-link and multi-currency evidence and verify unknown values remain separate, no cross-currency total is shown and no source record is changed.

human_gate.reason: Read-only arithmetic over repository evidence and non-production validation only. Supplier contact, real payment, accounting posting, tax action, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
